notes.title: Snip It! Version 1.2 Released
notes.notes:
Hey, happy Friday!

Snip It! version 1.2 releases today. Patch notes:

[list]
[*] The Steam overlay is now working! F12 will take screenshots etc.
[*] Four more achievements have been added!
[*] Updated controller settings (still working on Steam Deck verification)
[/list]
I'm working with Steam support to fix any issues with Steam Deck. If you're having trouble on Steam Deck or controller, please let me know! I don't have one so it's tough to test, lol.

My to-do:

[list]
[*] Implement cloud saves so levels unlocked and powerups counts will stay with you
[*] Revamp the level select screen so you can choose any level you've unlocked
[*] Possibly more achievements!
[*] Update controller configuration to work better with Steam Deck
[/list]
Enjoy!

-ryshaw

notes.title: Snip It! Version 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
Hey Snipsters!

I've been working on an update for a while now, and I'm excited to show you the new version of Snip It!

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] The player can now move in ANY direction and will draw over your current path, so you can't get stuck by your own path anymore.
[*] Native controller support has been implemented!
[*] The controls and in-game glyphs have been updated to comply with Steam Deck regulations
[*] Twelve achievements have been added!
[*] Plus a couple of minor updates and bug fixes
[/list]
There's still a few things I want to work on. One annoying bug is my Steam overlay integration isn't working correctly, so you still can't use F12 to take screenshots. Other than that, I have some ideas for a cheap paid DLC!

Please let me know any comments or suggestions in the discussion board or your reviews. Thank you for playing my game!

Enjoy!
ryshaw
